ACT XXI OF 2015
ACT
XXI OF 2015
LAHORE
ARTS COUNCIL (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015
An
Act further to amend the Lahore Arts Council Ordinance, 2002 (LXIII of 2002)
[Gazette
of Punjab Extraordinary
14th April, 2015]
No. PAP/Legis-2(63)/2015/1218, dated
14-4-2015.---The Lahore Arts Council (Amendment) Bill 2015, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on April 6, 2015, and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on April 10, 2015, is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Whereas it is expedient further to amend
the Lahore Arts Council Ordinance, 2002 (LXIII of 2002) for purposes
hereinafter appearing;
It is enacted as follows:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Lahore Arts Council (Amendment) Act, 2015.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment in section 8 of Ordinance LXIII of 2002
